eval_set: data/sql/val.jsonl first 100 rows (not used in training)
training: Soup SFT, LoRA r=16 alpha=32, 60 single-question rows from data/sql/train.jsonl, 1 epoch = 60 steps, layer streaming on
decoding: greedy, max_new_tokens=96, Qwen chat template from the adapter dir
caveats: exact-match is string match after whitespace/case/quote normalisation; equivalent SQL with different text counts as wrong
'executes' only checks the SQL runs on an EMPTY table built from the CREATE TABLE in the prompt; it is NOT accuracy
base output has markdown fences stripped before scoring (exact_match_raw_output is without stripping)
only 60 training steps on 60 examples; a single run, no seeds, no confidence interval
evaluated resident (4-bit NF4 + LoRA via PEFT), not through Soup's layer-streaming path; the adapter is the thing under test
